AccountType.title: AccountType
AccountType.description:
Account categories that select the customer-liability cap (RBC-CB paras 67-71, report B5).

The caps themselves are rule-pack parameters, never constants in code.

AppliesTo.title: AppliesTo
AppliesTo.description: Applicability profile: which regulated entities the obligation binds.

BasisStatus.title: BasisStatus
BasisStatus.description: Whether the instrument states the day basis or the research inferred it.

stop_date.title: Stop Date
stop_date.description: When the stop event came, if late.

days_late.title: Days Late
days_late.description: Days past due_date at stop_date or as_of.

Breach.title: Breach
Breach.description: A deadline missed: no stop by ``due_date``, or a stop after it.

broken_at.title: Broken At
broken_at.description: Index of the first bad record.

ChainStatus.title: ChainStatus
ChainStatus.description: Whether a complaint's decision-record hash chain verifies.

Channel.title: Channel
Channel.description: Payment channel of a transaction, as in the failed-transaction TAT annex (report B1/B2).

open_question.title: Open Question
open_question.description: Open-question ID authorising the pause, e.g. 'Q3'.

ClockPause.title: ClockPause
ClockPause.description: A pause rule. No obligation may use one until open question Q3 is resolved by the owner.

ClockSpec.title: ClockSpec
ClockSpec.description:
When the clock starts and stops, and how its days are counted.

``start`` is an event type, or the name of a ``ComplaintFacts`` date field when the anchor is a
fact rather than an event (for example ``transaction_date_t`` for the failed-transaction TAT).
``stop`` lists the events that stop the clock; any one of them is enough.

formula.title: Formula
formula.description: E.g. '100 x max(0, R - (T + n))' rupees.

Compensation.title: Compensation
Compensation.description: Money owed, with the formula and inputs that produced it.

ComplaintDetail.title: ComplaintDetail
ComplaintDetail.description: Everything the complaint view shows, as evaluated at ``as_of``.

ComplaintEvent.title: ComplaintEvent
ComplaintEvent.description:
One append-only business event on a complaint.

``occurred_at`` is business time (when it happened); ``recorded_at`` is system time (when the
engine learned of it). Both must be timezone-aware. ``payload`` holds event-specific facts, for
example ``{"outcome": "WHOLLY_REJECTED"}`` on ``OUTCOME_SET``.

home_branch_state.description: Home branch state as an ISO 3166-2:IN code without 'IN-'.

external_tat_days.description: RBI/NPCI/card-network TAT in days, when one applies (A2, A13).

ComplaintFacts.title: ComplaintFacts
ComplaintFacts.description: What the engine knows about one complaint. Dates are Asia/Kolkata calendar dates.

obligation_ids.title: Obligation Ids
obligation_ids.description: Obligations triggered on this complaint (applicable and triggered).

ComplaintSummary.title: ComplaintSummary
ComplaintSummary.description: One row of the deadline board.

ConditionTrace.title: ConditionTrace
ConditionTrace.description: One condition checked, in order, and its result.

DayBasis.title: DayBasis
DayBasis.description: How days are counted for a regulatory duration.

Deadline.title: Deadline
Deadline.description: A computed deadline; ``due_date`` is the last IST day on which stopping is on time.

obligation_version.title: Obligation Version
obligation_version.description: Rule-pack version or file hash of the obligation.

anchor_date.title: Anchor Date
anchor_date.description: Date used to select parameter versions.

DecisionRecord.title: DecisionRecord
DecisionRecord.description: The replayable record of one obligation evaluation. See the module docstring.

position.title: Position
position.description: Index of the record in the complaint's chain.

DecisionReplay.title: DecisionReplay
DecisionReplay.description: One decision record and the status of the chain it belongs to.

DecisionResult.title: DecisionResult
DecisionResult.description: Outcome of evaluating one obligation on one complaint at ``as_of``.

Deontic.title: Deontic
Deontic.description: Deontic type of an obligation: must, must not, or may.

EntityType.title: EntityType
EntityType.description: Regulated-entity type, used for applicability profiles (report A12 and open question Q2).

EventType.title: EventType
EventType.description: Business event types (report architecture diagram [3] and clock table).

FactSource.title: FactSource
FactSource.description: Who asserted a fact: a person, a bank system feed, or an LLM extraction.

InputFact.description: One fact the evaluation read, with where it came from.

NextDeadline.title: NextDeadline
NextDeadline.description: The earliest open deadline on a complaint.

anchor.title: Anchor
anchor.description: ComplaintFacts date that selects parameter versions; default: clock start.

Obligation.title: Obligation
Obligation.description: One obligation file. Field order mirrors the report's example YAML.

Outcome.title: Outcome
Outcome.description: The only three complaint outcomes allowed by IO Directions 2026 cl. 14(2) (report A14).

ParameterUse.title: ParameterUse
ParameterUse.description: A dated rule parameter resolved for this evaluation.

reference.title: Reference
reference.description: Clause or source of this value.

open_question.title: Open Question
open_question.description: Open-question ID when the value is flagged, e.g. 'Q5'.

ParameterValue.title: ParameterValue
ParameterValue.description: One dated value of a rule parameter.

actor.title: Actor
actor.description: User or system ID for HUMAN/SYSTEM.

Provenance.title: Provenance
Provenance.description: Where a fact came from: a person or system (``actor``), or an LLM (model, prompt, span).

RequiredAction.title: RequiredAction
RequiredAction.description: Something the bank must do next, with its due date.

RuleStatus.title: RuleStatus
RuleStatus.description: Lifecycle status of an obligation. Only the owner sets ``IN_FORCE``.

document_ref.title: Document Ref
document_ref.description: ID or URI of the source text (masked).

TextSpan.title: TextSpan
TextSpan.description: A character span in a source document that an extracted fact came from.

Trigger.title: Trigger
Trigger.description: The event (and optional condition over complaint facts) that makes the obligation bite.

Verification.title: Verification
Verification.description: Research verification grade of a rule or parameter (report grades P/S/U/C).
